stacks.name: a7R catch friction shunt, stiff bound: once a lean rests on the saddle (contact normal > ~120 N holds the 2.5 mm saddle face square), the legs act fixed-guided, 12 E I / L^3 x 2 (E 3000), at the largest stop setting stop_gap_max; limit the 10 N dead band. The designer's catch_k (3 E I / L^3) is neither bound: free saddle with the contact 8.9 above the leg tips gives 10.2 N/mm. cad/review/a7/scripts/head_a7.py

Limit = rear-strip buckling (4407 N) / 3. cad/review/a7/scripts/head_a7.py
